name: feedback/skeleton
title: Skeleton shimmer system
description: Placeholders shaped like the content to come.

files.content:
export { Skeleton, SkeletonGroup } from './Skeleton';
export type { SkeletonGroupProps, SkeletonProps } from './Skeleton';

notes: `SkeletonGroup` marks its region `aria-busy` while loading and contains a status message naming what is loading.
The placeholder shapes are hidden from assistive technology; they carry no content.
In forced-colours mode the shapes get a dashed outline so they stay visible.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The shimmer stops; placeholders are shown as still shapes.
